text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Spring Fan Thanksgiving. An annual event held to entertain the fans.
As for Marvelous Sunday—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Teache~r!
I finished restocking the bandages and gauze!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She was working as a first aid responder at the medical station set up in a corner of the track grounds.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Hauu~...
I came to ask for a repair...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Oh dear, where are you hurt?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...I scraped my leg.
I calculated the 'distance' to the ball, but
my 'synapse' connection was delayed...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe
became a "satellite"……

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text: Wait, satellites...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe commands complex words.
I've heard her unique way of speaking is simply because she's too smart.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I see, you swung, missed, and took a tumble.
Don't worry, the teacher will patch you up right away!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I'm counting on you...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday seemed to understand Neo Universe's
words. Thanks to that, we were able
to successfully administer first aid.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text: "Honestly, having Marvelous around is such a huge help. Just like earlier, she properly understands my instructions and helps out, making everything so easy."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That's surprising. I completely pegged you
as someone who only specialized in stirring up trouble.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume Air Shakur, cloaked in a sharp aura, mutters a scathing critique.
I instinctively glance over at her—and voice the question that crosses my mind.
choice_data_list: …Are you on the first-aid team too?
...Are you on the first-aid squad too?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "Haaah? Do I look like the type of guy to do that?"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Shakur isn't feeling well.
She said wasting time on soccer gives her a headache☆

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Shut up! Your rescue team
told me to rest here!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yep, that's what the first aid tent is for☆
The teacher said it's a place that welcomes everyone★

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ( R O O O A R )

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh? Did you just say—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... Here?
What's in the first aid station...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The one who burst in was Manhattan Cafe.
Rumored to see otherworldly things... is she talking to empty space right now, too!?
choice_data_list: Ah, um... who are you talking to...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Ah... Um... My 'friend' suddenly bolted over here, so...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...It looks like she's
trying to tell us something, but...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: ...I see~☆

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
“Observing” ERDI...
Wait, the “wavelength” isn't matching...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Usually I can hear it clearly,
but right now, even I can't catch it...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Where the hell are you looking!?
Every single one of you has lost their mind!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You can't hear me, Shakur?
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Cafe, lend me your strength!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Marvelouuus☆ Cafe's world and
my world have connected★

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: WHAAAAT?! Where the hell is this?!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: You "connected"... to the "in-between", did you?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Makes no damn sense! No way in hell!!
How the hell can something this unreal actually happen?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (THUMP-THUMP-THUMP-THUMP!)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Friend" is... asking to be heard,
appealing to us...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I can't hear you! I ain't listening to nothing!
Whatever you're trying to say has nothing to do with me!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
—Shakur, why are you covering your ears?
It's such a waste not to listen.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
If you don't ask, if you don't learn, it stays at zero.
But once you learn, your data points increase by one.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You want to gather data, right Shakur?
Maybe whatever comes after that will lead you to something marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"If it were actually useful data, sure!
But other people's voices are nothin' but noise!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Hmm, true, it might turn into background noise sometimes ☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Still, what you do after knowing is another matter. ☆
Deciding what to keep and what to toss is up to you, right? ★

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hah... She looks flexible enough, 
but she's ridiculously stubborn...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Life must be pretty easy
with skin as thick as yours.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: !? Wha— The PC is going haywire—!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
――Huh?
...Did they... come back...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Connect" is "severed"...
Did repulsion occur...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Something like that, I suppose.
It seems our 'friend' has gone off somewhere."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"PC checks out fine too, huh...
What was all that about, seriously...?"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: "I felt an extremely strong will from Cafe's 'friend', though――"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
If you're completely fine, that means
neither of you backed down, right?! ☆
Marvelooous! ★☆★

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Dude, don't say such terrifying crap with a straight face!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Well... considering it our win isn't a bad way to look at it, I guess...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the four of them smiled at each other, looking somehow relieved.
...However, I couldn't see or hear a thing.
What had just happened remained a complete mystery.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, don't mind it, don't mind it☆
It seems my "little friend"
had something they only wanted to tell the two of us★

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
――Huh?
...Did they... come back...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Contact"... Made, just for an instant?
That light is... the "course"...?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The light...... Yeah, I saw it too.
Dunno how to put it... but it didn't feel bad.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Beyond that light...
my "friend" raced ahead...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! That was sooo marvelous☆
Beyond that light, there's a whole bunch of marvelous waiting for us★☆

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...Then are you going for it? Beyond the light.
You've got Marvelous, don't you?"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Mmm, I wonder. I don't really know yet☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to gather my own Marvelous.
And along the way, maybe our lights
will cross paths again. ☆

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "Hmph... Guess you don't just accept everything as 'marvelous,' huh."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! You're the same way, Shakur☆
The most important Marvelous is right inside me★☆

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the four of them smiled at each other, looking somehow relieved.
...However, I couldn't see or hear a thing.
What had just happened remained a complete mystery.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, don't mind it, don't mind it☆
Looks like my "little friend"
just had something to tell the two of us★
